long_biography.plain_text:
Lekatsas founded Global IT around the turn of the millennium after working in the Swiss technology market. From Neerach, the company developed infrastructure, cloud, security and managed-service capabilities for businesses and public institutions. Its position as a major supplier to the Swiss defence department reflected a long operating focus on complex institutional clients.

In 2024, enthus Group acquired Global IT to deepen its Swiss presence. Lekatsas sold his ownership, reinvested in the acquiring group and remained during the transition, preserving operational continuity while moving from founder-owner toward succession. He later appeared in Swiss succession discussions as Global IT’s former owner. The transition ended his formal Global IT board role in July 2024.
